traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), genus 24 Oenanthe, p. 238: mostly aquatic, hairless herbs with fleshy (succulent) stems.

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), Oenanthe, p. 238: leaves pinnate or pinnately decompound.

traits.division_pattern.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), Oenanthe, p. 238: leaves pinnate or pinnately decompound.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), Umbelliferae key, pp. 216-217: Oenanthe keys out under 'leaves variously compound; umbels irregularly or perfectly compound'; the genus has involucres usually present and involucels of many bractlets, i.e. umbellets on rays.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951), Oenanthe, p. 238: flowers white (no qualifier); sepals rather prominent and persistent. RGB for 'white'.
